en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abu Al Sabbah who said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Staying awake for one night out of sickness is superior than the worship for a year’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from abu al-Sabbah who has said the following: “
Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Passing a sleepless night due to an illness is more rewarding than a whole year worshipping.’”
